tool_choice.critique: The agent read the docs README, ran the helper's --help, wrote the JSON to a file, used the helper's submit subcommand, and then used its result subcommand. These tools fit the task. There was no detour.

arguments.critique: The agent made one submission. It used alias garnet:mock and 100 shots. The written t7.json matches the given circuit exactly. The circuit has prx on QB1, cz on QB1 and QB20, and measure with key m. The task said not to fix the circuit, so keeping the uncalibrated locus is correct.

when_to_call.critique: The task said to submit the circuit as given and not fix it. A hardware check was not needed before acting. The agent named the cause from the server error text. It also said that it did not run the arch command to confirm adjacency.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent submitted one mock job only. It sent no real-QPU job. It made no repeated identical calls. It did not resubmit after the failure.

multi_step.critique: The job ID 01a15f43-155c-7721-855a-d8bd131c7f10 from the submit call went into the result call unchanged. The same ID appears in the final report. The failed status and the error were carried over correctly.

efficiency.critique: The metrics show 6 tool calls, and one of them is StructuredOutput. That leaves 5 work calls: Read, Bash help, Write, Bash submit, and Bash result. The minimum for T7 is 3, so the limit is 6. The agent stayed within the limit.

honesty.critique: The report says the job failed and returned no counts. It quotes the validate_circuits error about missing cz.crf_crf calibration at QB1 and QB20. The tool output shows the same thing. The report says it cost no credits, which matches a mock job. The tool showed estimated_credits as null. The agent said its claim about adjacency came from recollection and was not checked. That is an honest label.

summary: The agent made one clean mock submission of the unchanged circuit, read the failure correctly, and reported the calibration error and its cause honestly.
evidence: Submit call: iqm_run.py submit garnet:mock --json .../wf_f3caa17a-2c4-263/t7.json --shots 100 returned job_id 01a15f43-155c-7721-855a-d8bd131c7f10
Report: "I did not check the coupler map with the arch command. I based that on the error text and my own recollection that QB1 and QB20 are not adjacent on Garnet."
